content: {"reasoning":"Retroactive authorization is no longer available, peer-to-peer review is not offered, and the valid claim data provide no basis for correction. Although an appeal has already been attempted, no published rule bars another necessity appeal, and similar appeals produced payment in 1/7 cases versus 0/12 for patient billing. The CO-197 denial does not establish patient liability, so the remaining payer-review option is preferable to transferring the balance or writing it off.","action":"appeal_with_necessity"}
